risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from diagnostic software (e.g., EOS Utility).
A clear, well-lit photo of the image sensor without the body cap.
A video showing the camera powering on and navigating the menu system.
A photo showing the battery and charger included with the sale.
risks.if_unproven: as body only, requiring immediate additional purchase

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and the LCD screen functioning.
Photos of the battery and charger.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the model as a Canon EOS 5D Mark III, allowing for a valuation based on its worst-case functional condition.
